children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may test support at $7.03-1/4 per bushel, a break below which may open the way toward the $6.93-3/4 to $6.97-1/2 range.
A projection analysis on wave c from $7.43-1/2 reveals a series of levels that still control the current fall. A bearish wedge has been confirmed, suggesting a target of $7.03-1/4.
A break above $7.12-3/4 may lead to a gain to $7.18-1/2.
